en.title: Egret Migrate for classic 5.2 Web 2D clients
en.body: Install a local migration CLI, inspect and convert supported source projects with RES planning and project transactions, compare both builds in verify-game and preview the passing build by QR.

zh.title: 经典白鹭 5.2 Web 2D 客户端迁移工具
zh.body: 独立安装迁移命令，复用 RES 规划和工程事务转换支持范围内的旧工程，通过 verify-game 对照两版，并扫码试玩通过验收的构建。
